name: Saving Sharpbeak
summary: At Jintha'Alor, Sharpbeak waits in a cage deep in Vilebranch territory. Gryphon Master Talonaxe sends you to free him, and Vile Priestess Hexx holds the key.

sections.title: Up Jintha'Alor
sections.body: After Thadius Grimshade's divination, you report to Talonaxe. Now the path to Sharpbeak is clear. Jintha'Alor lies at the heart of Vilebranch territory, and you fight your way to its summit. Vile Priestess Hexx holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage. Take it from her, then find the cage and free the gryphon.

sections.title: Talonaxe's Thanks
sections.body: Swiftwind and Keenclaw have brought their child home, and they cannot stop fussing over him. The sight leaves Talonaxe misty-eyed. He says the debt cannot be repaid. Aerie Peak's gryphons and riders will sing your name for a long time.

faq.q: Who sends you to rescue Sharpbeak?
aliases: where do i start saving sharpbeak
faq.answer: Gryphon Master Talonaxe sends you to rescue Sharpbeak after Thadius Grimshade's divination reveals where the gryphon is held.
Sharpbeak is caged at the summit of Jintha'Alor, in Vilebranch territory in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage?
